Dunkirk, Indiana! We'll see you tomorrow night!!

Come enjoy some delicious food, brews and blues with East on Division @ The Firehouse BBQ and Blues in Dunkirk, IN  on June 27 from 6:30pm to 9:30pm.

Free show. All ages. Bring the family with you and come spend the night with us!

Dunkirk! One week left to go!

Come enjoy delicious barbecue and brews and listen to blues (including some new original material!) with East on Division @ The Firehouse BBQ and Blues in Dunkirk, IN on June 27 from 6:30pm to 9:30pm.

Free show. All ages. Come hang, grab some food, and spend Saturday night with us. 

🤘🏻 🎸 🎵

Thank you, Portland! We had a great time playing for you at the 1st Annual Flavor on Wheels Festival !

The event seemed to be a big success, and we had a blast. We're excited to see how the event grows and improves next year.

Big shout-out to our biggest fans who helped spread the news by sharing and engaging with our posts: Dylan Franks , Brenda DeWitt , Alisha Carpenter , and The Scoop Station  ❤️❤️❤️

Don't forget that our next show is East on Division @ The Firehouse BBQ and Blues in Dunkirk, IN on June 27! (I was right!)

Also, make sure to follow our page for a HUGE announcement that we've been COOKING - we may be opening for a REALLY COOL duo that you may have heard of.... Official announcement to follow soon!

TOMORROW

Come out, grab some food, and stick around for blues-soaked rock & roll.
